title: blitum bonus-henricus
intro: Blitum bonus-henricus, commonly known as American wormwood or pig squeak, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Amaranthaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and easing menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce spasms, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Blitum bonus-henricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
